content:
Structure your Seedance 2 prompt as a shot-by-shot list with exact timestamps (e.g., SHOT 1 00:00–00:01 … SHOT 13 00:14–00:15) to control pacing and edits.

Specify camera motion with measurable values (e.g., macro push-in, orbit 270° in 1s, punch forward 40% scale in 0.4s, 24mm lens, hip-height tracking, slow crane-up).

Control perceived time using explicit speed ramps and playback percentages (e.g., 25%→100% acceleration, ~10% bullet-time, ~5% air-pause, ~20% slow-mo).

Define transition/exits per shot to guide cuts (e.g., white bloom wipe, whip pan left-to-right blur, blade flare, debris-driven motion blur, hard cut on impact, lens flare burst, flame-flash wipe, gentle bloom fade).

Call out specific VFX overlays and effects in the prompt (e.g., cyan light bloom, chromatic aberration, volumetric god rays, lens flare spikes, screen shake, radial blur, shockwave displacement, chromatic shatter, HUD glyph overlay, stroboscopic multi-exposure clones, motion trails).

Use “frozen 360° orbit” / “time-stopped feel” language to lock action while moving the camera around the subject.

Add “90° camera rotation” and “gravity inverts” to prompt a vertical run/climb with an inverting horizon effect.

Use an “eye reflection match-cut” instruction to transition into a title reveal (ECU eye → reflection shows scene → glitch text → fade to black).

SHOT 2 (00:01–00:02) — Bullet-Time Reveal EFFECT: Frozen 360° orbit + volumetric god rays + falling debris suspended mid-air Camera orbits her crouched silhouette at 270° in one second, sparks and ash hang frozen Speed: ~10% playback, time-stopped feel SIGNATURE VISUAL EFFECT EXITS via whip pan (left-to-right blur) 
SHOT 3 (00:02–00:03) — Rise & Draw EFFECT: Speed ramp (acceleration 25%→100%) + heavy motion blur She rises, deploys an energy blade from forearm in one fluid motion, blade ignites cyan Low-angle dolly-up, lens at 24mm EXITS on blade flare 
SHOT 4 (00:03–00:04) — First Strike EFFECT: Whip pan + crash zoom + screen shake Camera whips with her swing. Blade slices a drone mid-flight, sparks explode Frame jitters on impact frame EXITS via debris-driven motion blur 
SHOT 5 (00:04–00:05) — Roll-Through EFFECT: Steadicam tracking + speed ramp (deceleration on landing) She rolls under incoming fire, plasma bolts streak past in slow-mo Camera tracks beside her at hip height EXITS hard cut on boot impact 
SHOT 6 (00:05–00:06) — Vertical Climb EFFECT: 90° camera rotation + parallax pull + depth haze She runs up a collapsed steel beam vertically. Camera rotates with her so gravity inverts EXITS on apex frame 
SHOT 7 (00:06–00:07) — Air-Pause EFFECT: Frozen frame + radial blur + cyan energy charge VFX Mid-leap, she stops in mid-air. Energy spirals into the blade ~5% speed, 360° micro-orbit EXITS via lens flare burst SHOT 8 (00:07–00:09) — Ground Slam EFFECT: Crash zoom + shockwave displacement + screen-wide chromatic shatter She crashes blade-first into concrete, shockwave ring distorts the frame Dust plume erupts in slow-mo (~20%) EXITS on dust wall SHOT 9 (00:09–00:10) — Through The Dust EFFECT: Push-through transition + soft focus pull Camera punches through dust cloud, emerges on her crouched silhouette, cyan eyes burning through fog EXITS clean SHOT 10 (00:10–00:11) — Three Drones Inbound EFFECT: Multi-target HUD overlay + rack focus + speed ramp POV-style — three drones lock on, HUD glyphs flicker, focus racks across each one EXITS via head-turn whip 
SHOT 11 (00:11–00:13) — Triple Takedown EFFECT: Stroboscopic multi-exposure clone + speed ramp + motion trails Three ghost-instances of her appear mid-strike, blade trails arc cyan, drones explode in sequence ~15% then ramp to 100% SIGNATURE EFFECT #2 EXITS via flame-flash wipe 
SHOT 12 (00:13–00:14) — Hero Stand EFFECT: Slow crane-up + volumetric backlight + subtle frame rotation (~8° CCW) She stands, blade lowered, embers drifting up. Wrecked tower frames her Camera rises slowly to reveal scale EXITS via gentle bloom SHOT 13 (00:14–00:15) — Title Lock EFFECT: Eye reflection match-cut + cyan glitch text reveal Cut to ECU her eye — reflection shows the burning tower "MO" text glitches in over reflection Holds 0.5s, fade to black

translations.es:
Estructura tu prompt de Seedance 2 como una lista de tomas con marcas de tiempo exactas (por ejemplo, SHOT 1 00:00–00:01 … SHOT 13 00:14–00:15) para controlar el ritmo y las ediciones.

Especifica el movimiento de la cámara con valores medibles (por ejemplo, macro push-in, órbita 270° en 1s, punch forward 40% scale en 0.4s, lente de 24mm, seguimiento a la altura de la cadera, grúa lenta hacia arriba).

Controla el tiempo percibido usando rampas de velocidad explícitas y porcentajes de reproducción (por ejemplo, aceleración 25%→100%, ~10% bullet-time, ~5% air-pause, ~20% slow-mo).

Define transiciones/salidas por toma para guiar los cortes (por ejemplo, white bloom wipe, whip pan left-to-right blur, blade flare, motion blur impulsado por escombros, hard cut on impact, lens flare burst, flame-flash wipe, gentle bloom fade).

Menciona superposiciones y efectos VFX específicos en el prompt (por ejemplo, cyan light bloom, chromatic aberration, volumetric god rays, lens flare spikes, screen shake, radial blur, shockwave displacement, chromatic shatter, HUD glyph overlay, stroboscopic multi-exposure clones, motion trails).

Usa el lenguaje “frozen 360° orbit” / “time-stopped feel” para bloquear la acción mientras mueves la cámara alrededor del sujeto.

Añade “90° camera rotation” y “gravity inverts” para provocar una carrera/escalada vertical con un efecto de horizonte invertido.

Usa una instrucción de “eye reflection match-cut” para hacer la transición a una revelación de título (ECU eye → reflection shows scene → glitch text → fade to black).

--- CONTINUACIÓN DEL HILO ---
[Thread 1] SHOT 1 (00:00–00:01) — Eye Ignition EFFECT: Macro push-in + cyan light bloom + chromatic aberration ECU en el ojo cerrado del cyborg. El párpado se abre de golpe. El iris cian se enciende violentamente, lens flare spikes a través del cuadro. La cámara avanza 40% scale en 0.4s, luego se bloquea. EXITS via white bloom wipe 
SHOT 2 (00:01–00:02) — Bullet-Time Reveal EFFECT: Frozen 360° orbit + volumetric god rays + falling debris suspended mid-air La cámara orbita su silueta agachada a 270° en un segundo, chispas y cenizas quedan suspendidas. Velocidad: ~10% playback, time-stopped feel SIGNATURE VISUAL EFFECT EXITS via whip pan (left-to-right blur) 
SHOT 3 (00:02–00:03) — Rise & Draw EFFECT: Speed ramp (acceleration 25%→100%) + heavy motion blur Ella se levanta, despliega una espada de energía desde el antebrazo en un movimiento fluido, la espada se enciende cian. Dolly-up en ángulo bajo, lente a 24mm EXITS on blade flare 
SHOT 4 (00:03–00:04) — First Strike EFFECT: Whip pan + crash zoom + screen shake La cámara se mueve con su golpe. La espada corta un dron en pleno vuelo, las chispas explotan. El cuadro tiembla en el impacto. EXITS via debris-driven motion blur 
SHOT 5 (00:04–00:05) — Roll-Through EFFECT: Steadicam tracking + speed ramp (deceleration on landing) Ella rueda bajo el fuego entrante, los rayos de plasma pasan en slow-mo. La cámara la sigue a la altura de la cadera. EXITS hard cut on boot impact 
SHOT 6 (00:05–00:06) — Vertical Climb EFFECT: 90° camera rotation + parallax pull + depth haze Ella corre por una viga de acero colapsada verticalmente. La cámara rota con ella, invirtiendo la gravedad. EXITS on apex frame 
SHOT 7 (00:06–00:07) — Air-Pause EFFECT: Frozen frame + radial blur + cyan energy charge VFX En pleno salto, se detiene en el aire. La energía se arremolina en la espada. Velocidad ~5%, micro-órbita 360° EXITS via lens flare burst SHOT 8 (00:07–00:09) — Ground Slam EFFECT: Crash zoom + shockwave displacement + screen-wide chromatic shatter Ella impacta con la espada primero en el concreto, el anillo de onda de choque distorsiona el cuadro. Una nube de polvo estalla en slow-mo (~20%) EXITS on dust wall SHOT 9 (00:09–00:10) — Through The Dust EFFECT: Push-through transition + soft focus pull La cámara atraviesa la nube de polvo, emerge en su silueta agachada, ojos cian brillando a través de la niebla. EXITS clean SHOT 10 (00:10–00:11) — Three Drones Inbound EFFECT: Multi-target HUD overlay + rack focus + speed ramp Estilo POV — tres drones se fijan en ella, los glifos del HUD parpadean, el enfoque cambia entre cada uno. EXITS via head-turn whip 
SHOT 11 (00:11–00:13) — Triple Takedown EFFECT: Stroboscopic multi-exposure clone + speed ramp + motion trails Tres instancias fantasma de ella aparecen en medio del golpe, las estelas de la espada arcan cian, los drones explotan en secuencia. ~15% luego aumenta a 100% SIGNATURE EFFECT #2 EXITS via flame-flash wipe 
SHOT 12 (00:13–00:14) — Hero Stand EFFECT: Slow crane-up + volumetric backlight + subtle frame rotation (~8° CCW) Ella se levanta, espada baja, brasas flotando hacia arriba. Una torre destruida la enmarca. La cámara sube lentamente para revelar la escala. EXITS via gentle bloom SHOT 13 (00:14–00:15) — Title Lock EFFECT: Eye reflection match-cut + cyan glitch text reveal Corte a ECU su ojo — el reflejo muestra la torre en llamas. El texto "MO" se distorsiona sobre el reflejo. Mantiene 0.5s, fade to black

명시적인 속도 램프와 재생 비율을 사용하여 인지된 시간을 제어하세요 (예: 25%→100% 가속, ~10% 총알 시간, ~5% 공중 정지, ~20% 슬로우 모션).
